qualifier: via eIF2-alpha kinases HRI, GCN2 and mitochondrial stress
name: Integrated stress response via eIF2-alpha kinases and mitochondrial stress
rationale: All members concern stress-induced eIF2-alpha/ATF4 translational control and unfolded protein responses; HRI, GCN2 and mitochondrial UPR members set it apart from the ATF6/IRE1/XBP1 ER-stress confusables.

name: Osteoclast fusion, differentiation and bone resorption
rationale: Members regulate osteoclast/macrophage fusion, differentiation, proliferation and bone resorption; fusion and DAP12 members distinguish it from CSF1, osteoblast and IGF confusables.

qualifier: downstream of lysophospholipid receptors and VEGFR2
name: Phospholipase C–IP3 calcium signaling via LPA receptors and VEGFR2
rationale: Members share Gq/PLC-driven inositol trisphosphate and calcium signaling; the LPA/S1P receptor and VEGFR2 members separate it from cAMP, PKC and prostanoid/leukotriene GPCR confusables.

name: Nucleoside, nucleobase and antiviral analogue membrane transport
rationale: All members concern transmembrane transport of purine/pyrimidine nucleosides and bases, including abacavir and ribavirin handling and SLC29A3 defects, unlike the nucleotide catabolism confusables.

core: Chromatin and nucleosome remodeling in transcription
name: Nucleosome remodeling by CHD/NuRD and histone methylation
rationale: Members concern nucleosome organization and chromatin regulation of transcription and repair; CHD/NuRD complexes and histone/TP53 methylation distinguish it from BAF-complex, acetylation and DNA-repair chromatin confusables.

core: RNA polymerase II transcription initiation and promoter escape
name: RNA polymerase II initiation and promoter escape, including HIV
rationale: All members cover Pol II pre-initiation, promoter opening, escape and early elongation complex formation, unlike the confusables focused on elongation, pausing and Tat-mediated HIV elongation.

name: Regulation of leukocyte–endothelial adhesion and extravasation
rationale: All members regulate leukocyte adhesion to vascular endothelium, adhesion-molecule production and extravasation, distinct from integrin/PECAM, endothelial activation and inflammatory cytokine confusables.

core: Vesicle tethering and targeting at Golgi
qualifier: regulated by Rab and ARF GTPases
name: Rab/ARF-regulated vesicle tethering and targeting at Golgi
rationale: Members concern vesicle targeting and tethering to and within the Golgi and constitutive secretion with Rab/ARF regulation, unlike COPI/COPII coat and Golgi organization confusables.

name: Lysosomal and endosomal vesicle fusion with Golgi-derived transport
rationale: Members concern fusion of autophagosomes, phagosomes, MVBs and endosomes with lysosomes and Golgi-to-endosome/lysosome transport, unlike the autophagosome assembly regulation confusables.

qualifier: with lymphoid and mucosal tissue development
name: Lymphocyte homing and lymphoid tissue development, including gut mucosa
rationale: Members cover S1P- and receptor-guided lymphocyte migration and lymph node, GALT and MALT development; the mucosal lymphoid members distinguish it from T cell and dendritic cell chemotaxis confusables.

qualifier: T and B antigen receptor signaling and costimulation
name: T and B cell antigen receptor signaling, costimulation and development
rationale: Members span TCR and BCR signaling, CD28/ICOS/CTLA4 costimulation, thymic selection and B cell differentiation; joint T and B content distinguishes it from B-lineage-only and NK-containing confusables.

name: IL-12–driven Th1 response and interferon-gamma production
rationale: Members concern IL-12 production and JAK-STAT signaling, Th1 cytokines and IFN-gamma production; IL-12 signaling and memory T cell members separate it from dendritic-cell and Th1-differentiation confusables.

name: RAS GAP inactivation and oncogenic RAS–MAPK pathway mutants
rationale: Members concern RAS negative regulation by GAPs/NF1 and signaling by mutant RAS, GAP and MAP2K proteins to RSK, unlike SOS-driven activation and ERK feedback confusables.

name: Histone and tubulin acetylation with tubulin glutamylation
rationale: Members concern lysine and N-terminal acetylation of histones and tubulin plus tubulin glutamylation/deglutamylation, distinguishing it from methylation and tubulin folding confusables.

name: p53 and mTORC1 regulation of glycolysis and pentose phosphate
rationale: Members tie p53 and mTORC1 programmes to regulation of glycolysis, the pentose-phosphate shunt and nucleotide catabolism, unlike FOXO, NRF2 and HIF confusables.

qualifier: driven by VEGF and Tie2 signaling
name: Endothelial angiogenesis and vessel morphogenesis via VEGF and Tie2
rationale: Members regulate endothelial differentiation, sprouting, proliferation and vessel patterning with VEGF/VEGFR, neuropilin and Tie2 signaling, unlike smooth muscle, shear stress and BMP-driven cardiovascular confusables.

name: Suppression of TNF–NF-kappaB inflammatory cytokine signaling
rationale: All members negatively regulate inflammatory cytokines (TNF, IL-6, IL-1beta) and TNF/NF-kappaB signaling, the latter distinguishing it from TLR and IL-10/IL-12 confusables.

name: Plasma membrane phospholipid asymmetry, scrambling and repair
rationale: Members concern flippase/scramblase control of aminophospholipid distribution, with blebbing, volume control and membrane repair separating it from ER lipid transfer and apoptotic clearance confusables.

name: FGFR-activated PLC-gamma and PI3K phosphoinositide cascades
rationale: All members are FGFR1-4 PLC or PI3K cascades or phosphatidylinositol signaling, unlike FRS/SHC-MAPK and ligand-binding confusables.

qualifier: NK inhibitory receptors and peripheral tolerance
name: Immunoregulatory NK, T and dendritic cell activation and tolerance
rationale: Members cover NK inhibitory receptors, Fc inhibitory signaling, T cell costimulation, anergy/tolerance and dendritic cell activation, unlike Treg-focused and NK cytotoxicity confusables.

name: Hedgehog signal transduction through smoothened and GLI
rationale: Members concern Hh ligand-receptor, SMO activation and ciliary localization and GLI transcription, whereas confusables are downstream embryonic patterning processes.

qualifier: small RNA pathways and AU-rich element binding proteins
name: Small RNA silencing and AU-rich element–mediated mRNA decay
rationale: Members cover miRNA/siRNA biogenesis and silencing plus ARE-binding protein and decapping-driven mRNA decay; the combination separates it from splicing, 3'-end processing and translation-control confusables.

name: MECP2 control of neuronal transcription and loss-of-function defects
rationale: All members concern MECP2 regulation, its neuronal target genes and its disease variants losing methyl-DNA binding or phosphorylation, unlike CREB/CaMK and behaviour confusables.

name: Apoptotic nuclear dismantling and DNA fragmentation
rationale: Members concern execution-phase DNA fragmentation, chromatin condensation and lamina breakdown, unlike the mitochondrial/apoptosome initiation confusables.

name: B cell activation, proliferation and germinal center costimulation
rationale: Members regulate B cell proliferation, survival, differentiation and germinal center reactions with Tfh, ICOS and CD27 costimulation, unlike plasma cell and B cell surface-signature confusables.
